name: AI Hug Video: Turn Two Photos Into a Warm Hug
blurb: An AI hug video is a short clip where two people from two separate photos walk toward each other and hug.

prompts.label: 1. Open [AI Photo with this template](https://www.makeviral.ai/photo?template=ai-hug-video) and add the two photos in this order: first person, then second person. The photo prompt is filled in
prompts.text: Use the two uploaded images as the base. Keep each person's face, facial features, skin tone, hair and clothing exactly the same as in their own photo. Do not blend the two people. Place both people in one realistic photo, standing a few steps apart and smiling at each other in a sunny park with soft golden light. Both are shown from the knees up. Photorealistic, vertical 9:16. No text, no logos, no other people.

prompts.label: 3. Press the film button on the still to open AI Video with the still as the first frame. Settings: Seedance 2.5, 8 s, 720p, 9:16, sound on. The video prompt
prompts.text: Two people stand a few steps apart in a sunny park. Keep both faces and outfits exactly as in the image. They smile, step toward each other, and share a warm, tight, friendly hug, swaying gently. One of them laughs softly. Slow camera arc around them, soft golden light, leaves moving in the wind. Audio: gentle original piano and birdsong. Wholesome and tender. No kissing, no text, no logos.
